title: The Missing Alarm Clock
content:
Detective Anna arrived at a small house in the morning. An alarm clock was missing from the bedroom.

— Where was the alarm clock? — she asked.

— It was on the nightstand — the owner said.

Anna looked under the bed, but it wasn't there.

Then she looked behind the curtains.

— Is there anything inside this drawer? — she asked.

— No, there isn't.

Anna walked into the living room. She saw a small box next to the sofa.

— What's in this box?

The owner opened it.

The alarm clock was inside!

— But how did it get there? — he asked.

Anna looked at the floor.

There were small footprints near the box.

She followed them to the kitchen.

The family dog was sleeping under the table.

The alarm clock was beside him!

Anna laughed.

— The mystery is solved. Your dog took it!

— So, he is the thief?

— Yes, but I don't think he will go to jail! — Anna replied.
